name: AWS — Config Recorder Stopped (Pre-Ransomware Evasion)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("StopConfigurationRecorder","DeleteConfigurationRecorder")
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as events,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: StopConfigurationRecorder or DeleteConfigurationRecorder event — defense evasion preceding impact-phase activity.
alert_description:
What fired: StopConfigurationRecorder or DeleteConfigurationRecorder event — defense evasion preceding impact-phase activity.

Why it matters: security controls, logging, or data are being disabled, deleted, or altered to evade detection. Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1562.008 - Impair Defenses: Disable Cloud Logs (TA0005 - Defense Evasion).

Investigate:
  - Identify what control/log/resource was changed and the principal that changed it.
  - Treat as high urgency: inspect the activity immediately BEFORE and AFTER the change — tampering usually hides something.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.

TA0005 - Defense Evasion: T1562.008 - Impair Defenses: Disable Cloud Logs
